Content.Learning: Yesterday I went to the park with my family
Content.Native: Вчера я ходил в парк со своей семьёй

Content.Learning: The sun was shining and the birds were singing
We brought sandwiches and fruit for a picnic
Content.Native: Мы принесли бутерброды и фрукты для пикника

Content.Learning: My little sister played on the swings
Content.Native: Моя младшая сестра играла на качелях

Content.Learning: I read a book under a large tree
Content.Native: Я читал книгу под большим деревом

Content.Learning: In the evening we walked around the lake
It was a wonderful day and everyone was happy
Content.Native: Это был чудесный день и все были счастливы
